name: The Monkees
description: Micky, Mike, Peter, and Davy are four young men in mid-1960s LA, members of a struggling country-folk-rock band looking for their big break amid madcap encounters with a variety of people straight out of TV and movie central casting, with full knowledge that their existence is part of a weekly television series.

videos.title: Here Come The Monkees (Pilot)
videos.overview: The original 16mm version of the pilot episode.

videos.title: 33 1/3 Revolutions Per Monkee
videos.overview: Four individuals are brainwashed into forming a musical group, featuring guest appearances from some of the superstars of 1950s rock 'n' roll.

videos.title: Vintage Monkees Kelloggs Commercials
videos.overview: A selection of commercials originally aired during the NBC run of The Monkees

videos.title: The Monkees In NYC
videos.overview: Footage of The Monkees from NBC News

videos.title: Secret Agent Sketch
videos.overview: A sketch from The Monkees appearance on the Glenn Campbell Goodtime Hour

videos.title: Touch Tone Symphony
videos.overview: A sketch from The Monkees appearance on the Glenn Campbell Goodtime Hour

videos.title: Hey, Hey, It's The Monkees
videos.overview: An hour-long special that aired on ABC finds Davy, Micky, Peter, and Mike looking back on the old days (with a medley of their hits) and promoting their 1996 CD "Justus" with 3 music videos from it.

videos.title: Hey, Hey We're the Monkees
videos.overview: Through interviews and vintage film footage including the TV series, concert tours and their pioneering music videos, all four Monkees provide insightful recollections of Monkeemania before, during and after. With a special appearance by Frank Zappa, the show also includes original screen tests, outtakes, TV commercials and rare photos of the band.

videos.title: We Love The Monkees
videos.overview: A look back at the story of Davy Jones and The Monkees.

videos.title: Royal Flush
videos.overview: The Monkees rescue Princess Bettina, Duchess of Harmonica (Katherine Walsh) from her evil uncle Archduke Otto (Theodore Marcuse).

videos.title: Monkee See, Monkee Die
videos.overview: The Monkees spend the night in a haunted house to collect an inheritance.

videos.title: Monkee vs. Machine
videos.overview: In a computerized toy factory, the Monkees foil an efficiency expert (Stan Freberg) who wants to replace an old toymaker (Walter Janovitz) with automation.

videos.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Kidnappers
videos.overview: A shady PR man (Andre Philippe) kidnaps the Monkees to prevent them from winning a talent contest in order for his clients (rival band the Four Swines) to win.

videos.title: The Spy Who Came in from the Cool
videos.overview: The Monkees get mixed up in a spy ring (Jacques Aubuchon, Arlene Martel) after Davy accidentally purchases a set of red maracas containing secret microfilm. Can the Monkees outwit two professional spies ?

videos.title: Success Story
videos.overview: Davy's grandfather (Ben Wright) visits, and the Monkees try to convince him that his grandson is wealthy and successful.

videos.title: Monkees in a Ghost Town
videos.overview: Stranded in a ghost town after their car runs out of gas, the Monkees are held prisoner by bank robbers (Len Lesser, Lon Chaney Jr.) and their boss, "The Big Man" (Rose Marie).

videos.title: Don't Look a Gift Horse in the Mouth
videos.overview: Davy is given a horse, which the Monkees have to hide from their landlord, Mr. Babbitt (Henry Corden). It is returned to a heart-broken child (Kerry MacLane) and father (Jim Boles) after Davy rides it to victory over the horse of the father's neighbor. Famed character actor, and frequent Bob Hope sideman, Jerry Colonna plays veterinarian Doctor Mann.

videos.title: The Chaperone
videos.overview: Davy's feelings for retired General Harley Vandenberg's (Arch Johnson) daughter Leslie (Sherry Alberoni) leads Micky to pose as a female chaperone at a party after the real chaperone (Diana Chesney) gets drunk.

videos.title: Here Come the Monkees - The Pilot
videos.overview: The Monkees play a sweet sixteen party and help the birthday girl (Robyn Millan) with her studies after she falls for Davy.

videos.title: Monkees à la Carte
videos.overview: The Monkees pose as the Purple Flower Gang to save their favourite Italian restaurant from a gangster (Harvey Lembeck).

videos.title: I've Got a Little Song Here
videos.overview: Mike is fleeced by a fraudulent music publisher (Phil Leeds), but Micky dons the guise of a flashy Hollywood producer to get Mike's money back.

videos.title: One Man Shy (Peter and the Debutante)
videos.overview: Bashful Peter tries to win the heart of lovely debutante Valerie Cartwright (Lisa James) while dealing with her haughty boyfriend Ronnie Farnsworth (George Furth).

videos.title: Dance, Monkee, Dance
videos.overview: The Monkees sign up for lessons at Renaldo's Dance Au Go Go (Hal March), and then find out that their contracts are for life.

videos.title: Too Many Girls (Davy and Fern)
videos.overview: A domineering stage mother tries to use Davy to further her daughter Fern's career.

videos.title: Son of a Gypsy
videos.overview: A band of gypsies, headed by the powerful Maria (Jeanne Arnold), force the Monkees to steal a priceless statuette called the "Maltese Vulture."

videos.title: The Case of the Missing Monkee
videos.overview: Peter becomes involved with the disappearance of the respected Professor Milo Schnitzler (Norbert Schiller) and then disappears himself.

videos.title: I Was a Teenage Monster
videos.overview: A mad scientist (John Hoyt) hires the Monkees to teach his monster (Richard Kiel) music—and then transplants their musical talent into the monster. Can the Monkees get their talent back? Byron Foulger appears as Groot, Dr. Mendoza's assistant.

videos.title: The Audition (Find the Monkees)
videos.overview: When television producer Hubbell Bensen (Carl Ballantine) hears a tape of the Monkees, he frantically stages auditions in the hope of finding them for his new television show, unaware they are desperately trying to audition for him.

videos.title: Monkees in the Ring
videos.overview: A crooked fight promoter (Ned Glass) prepares to cash in on a big bet by making Davy a stooge in a bout with the champ.

videos.title: The Prince and the Paupers
videos.overview: Davy doubles for a lookalike Peruvian prince in order to win the heart of Wendy Forsythe (Heather North) or forfeit his throne to evil Count Myron (Oscar Beregi Jr.).

videos.title: Monkees at the Circus
videos.overview: To save a bankrupt circus, the Monkees pose as a troupe of dazzling, supreme high-wire artists from France known as the Mozzarelli Brothers, but get in trouble when their guise requires them to actually perform.

videos.title: Captain Crocodile
videos.overview: The Monkees' appearance on popular children's show The Captain Crocodile Show is sabotaged by its host (Joey Forman), who fears that his guest's popularity is diminishing his own.

videos.title: Monkees à la Mode
videos.overview: The Monkees are chosen as "Typical Young Americans of the Year," by Chic magazine, a haughty publication that runs a bogus article on the group moulding them into a false image of clean cut young men.

videos.title: Alias Micky Dolenz
videos.overview: The police cash in on Micky's striking resemblance to imprisoned crime kingpin Baby Face Morales in an attempt to locate robbery loot.

videos.title: Monkee Chow Mein
videos.overview: Peter finds a secret message in a fortune cookie at a Chinese restaurant, forcing Monkeemen Davy and Mike to come to his rescue from the evil Dragonman (Joey Forman).

videos.title: Monkee Mother
videos.overview: Middle-aged widow Millie (Rose Marie) moves in with the Monkees as a new tenant, resulting in the boys' trying to find her a husband.

videos.title: Monkees on the Line
videos.overview: Hired by a telephone answering service, the Monkees are soon plunged into mix-ups, hang-ups and crossed wires leading to pursuit by a crooked bettor (Milton Frome).

videos.title: Monkees Get Out More Dirt
videos.overview: The Monkees' friendship is threatened when they all fall for the same girl, luscious local laundromat proprietress April Conquest (Julie Newmar).

videos.title: Monkees in Manhattan
videos.overview: In New York City, the Monkees fend off an irate hotel manager (Philip Ober) as they help a producer (Richard Anders) get backing for a Broadway musical.

videos.title: Monkees at the Movies
videos.overview: The Monkees have a run-in with a snobbish movie idol (Bobby Sherman) on the set as extras in a beach movie.

videos.title: Monkees on Tour
videos.overview: A mini-documentary chronicling a live Monkees concert gig on location in Phoenix, Arizona during their first public appearance tour.

videos.title: It's a Nice Place to Visit
videos.overview: In El Monotono, Mexico, Davy is captured by a bandito (Peter Whitney) and his minions for being "captivated" with El Diablo's girlfriend (Cynthia Hull).

videos.title: The Picture Frame
videos.overview: Peter must prove the Monkees' innocence when they unwittingly rob a bank in the pretext of making a movie for two con men (Cliff Norton, Kelton Garwood).

videos.title: Everywhere a Sheik, Sheik
videos.overview: It is a "harem-scare 'em" scene as Davy faces the prospect of marriage to a lovely Nehudian princess (Donna Loren).

videos.title: Monkee Mayor
videos.overview: Mike casts his wool hat into the ring to stop a crooked construction tycoon (Monte Landis) from turning the city into parking lots.

videos.title: Art, for Monkees' Sake
videos.overview: At an art museum, Peter copies an old painting for two guards (Monte Landis, Vic Tayback) who are actually thieves bent on snatching the real painting.

videos.title: I Was a 99 lb. Weakling
videos.overview: After losing his girlfriend Brenda to a muscle man named Bulk, Micky starts a health program under the guidance of fraudulent physical cultist Shah-Ku (Monte Landis).

videos.title: Hillbilly Honeymoon
videos.overview: Lost in Swineville, the Monkees get caught in the middle of a hillbilly feud between the Weskitts and Chubbers with Davy staring down the barrel of a shotgun wedding to pretty Ella Mae Chubber (Melody Patterson).

videos.title: Monkees Marooned
videos.overview: Peter trades his guitar for a con man’s treasure map. On a deserted island, the Monkees go hunting for treasure—and are hunted by a mad Australian (Monte Landis) and his man Thursday (Rupert Crosse).

videos.title: Card Carrying Red Shoes
videos.overview: Peter is the target of a romantic prima ballerina (Ondine Vaughn) and a dastardly plot choreographed by the rest of the ballet company.

videos.title: The Wild Monkees
videos.overview: The Monkees turn chicken when they unwittingly befriend the girlfriends of a tough motorcycle gang.

videos.title: A Coffin Too Frequent
videos.overview: A mad scientist (George Furth), his goony cousin (Mickey Morton), and his dotty aunt (Ruth Buzzi) use the Monkees' pad for a séance to summon their relative Elmer from beyond.

videos.title: Hitting the High Seas
videos.overview: Thoughts of mutiny are bountiful as the Monkees try to stop the hijack of a cargo ship by a vengeful sea captain (Chips Rafferty).

videos.title: Monkees in Texas
videos.overview: In the Lone Star State, the Monkees outwit Black Bart (Barton MacLane), his cohort Red (Len Lesser) and the gang to save Mike's Aunt Kate's (Jacqueline deWit) ranch.

videos.title: Monkees on the Wheel
videos.overview: In Las Vegas, the Monkees are mistaken for crooked gamblers by a roulette dealer (Rip Taylor) and policeman (Dort Clark) and try their luck at exposing the real gang (David Astor and Pepper Davis).

videos.title: The Christmas Show
videos.overview: The Monkees try to instil the spirit of Christmas in a cynical little boy (Butch Patrick) who has soured on the whole idea.

videos.title: Fairy Tale
videos.overview: A Monkee pantomime romp through Fairy Tale Land, introduced by a "Town Crier" (Rege Cordic), sees Peter rescuing a haughty princess (Michael) from death by her fiendish fiancee (Murray Roman).

videos.title: Monkees Watch Their Feet
videos.overview: A documented film report by the Department of UFO Information, headed by Pat Paulsen, shows the Monkees foiling an invasion by aliens (Stuart Margolin and Nita Talbot) from Planet Zlotnick.

videos.title: Monstrous Monkee Mash
videos.overview: The Monkees attempt to rescue Davy from his girlfriend Lorelei (Arlene Martel), Count Batula (Ron Masak), a wolf man (David Pearl), mummy man, and a Frankenstein-looking monster in a creepy castle.

videos.title: The Monkees' Paw
videos.overview: A broken-down magician's (Hans Conried) magical monkey's paw starts to bring the equally broken Monkees luck... unfortunately, all bad.

videos.title: The Devil and Peter Tork
videos.overview: At an eerie pawn shop, Peter unwittingly sells his soul to devilish character Mr. Zero (Monte Landis) in order to purchase a golden harp! Can Peter's musical talent save him from Mr. Zero's evil clutches forever ?

videos.title: Monkees Race Again
videos.overview: Davy drives the Monkeemobile in an auto race when the British entry is sabotaged by Baron Von Klutz (David Hurst) and his Klutzmobile. Featuring a cameo appearance by co-producer Bob Rafelson as the "World's Oldest Flower Child."

videos.title: The Monkees in Paris
videos.overview: The Monkees take a vacation from the studio grind and are chased (on location) all over the French Capital by beautiful girls and gendarme.

videos.title: Monkees Mind Their Manor
videos.overview: Davy inherits an English manor but must first win a tournament against Sir Twiggley Toppen Middle Bottom (Bernard Fox) with lances, swords and vocal cords.

videos.title: Some Like It Lukewarm
videos.overview: To enter and win a band contest hosted by radio DJ Jerry Blavat, David poses as a girl and falls in love with Daphne (Deana Martin), posing as a boy for her group who is also in the contest.

videos.title: Monkees Blow Their Minds
videos.overview: The Monkees swing to the rescue when mentalist Oracullo (Monte Landis) gains control of Peter's mind to use him in a nightclub act. Director James Frawley appears as Oracullo's assistant Rudy.

videos.title: Mijacogeo - The Frodis Caper
videos.overview: The Monkees match wits with the insane Wizard Glick (Rip Taylor), who is out to control the minds of television viewers worldwide.

awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 3 wins & 2 nominations total
